title: payment revision fixed failure profile
expected_root_cause: A new payment revision enabled the fixed payment-failure profile
mechanism: The faulty payment revision returns a bounded DB_POOL_TIMEOUT response for every synthetic authorization while the known-good revision remains ready.
impact_summary: Synthetic orders fail while traffic points to the faulty payment revision.
next_checks: Confirm the current payment traffic and revision image digest before approval.

action.title: Request payment revision rollback
action.description: Request approval to move only payment traffic to the captured known-good revision.
prerequisites: Verify the plan hash, source revision, target digest, and service etag.
action.expected_effect: Restore synthetic payment authorization and order success.
action.rollback_method: Move 100 percent of payment traffic to the captured known-good revision.
verification_steps: Confirm ten of ten bounded orders succeed.

expected_timeline.description: Traffic moves to a fixed payment-failure revision.
Synthetic order failures reach ten of ten.

evidence.title: Faulty payment revision became the sole traffic target
evidence.summary: The synthetic payment-failure revision received 100 percent traffic after the known-good revision and digest were captured.

evidence.title: Fixed payment profile returns DB pool timeouts
evidence.summary: Ten bounded synthetic payment requests returned DB_POOL_TIMEOUT from the faulty revision.

evidence.title: Synthetic order success dropped to zero
evidence.summary: The bounded live check observed zero successful orders while the faulty payment revision served traffic.
